name: omni-lang
description: Omni: cross-language parsing / multi-backend compilation architecture (stage0 bootstrap compiler, plain JS)

scripts.native: sh -c '[ -x dist/omni ] || npm run --silent build:native; exec ./dist/omni "$@"' --
scripts.check:self: node src/cli.js emit js src/cli.js > /dev/null && node src/cli.js emit c src/cli.js > /dev/null && echo "check:self ok（发射 + 链接器的模块名唯一性）"
scripts.fix:self: node src/cli.js emit c src/cli.js > dist/self-node.c && ./dist/omni emit c src/cli.js > dist/self-n1.c && cmp dist/self-node.c dist/self-n1.c && echo "fix:self ok（自己编自己，逐字节相同）"
